notes: Without the mode a debugging line is a comment, and text a COPY statement introduces from a debugging line is itself on a debugging line. A program without WITH DEBUGGING MODE and with 'D    COPY LIBN.' executes the copied DISPLAY (prints COPIED-ON-DLINE) while the plain D line beside it stays hidden. The copied tokens reach DebuggingLineRewriter without the debugging-line marker. kb/Work PB5214 holds the defect (code read: held-85/set2/decisions.json).

next.reason: 1985: "If the WITH DEBUGGING MODE clause is not specified in a program ... any debugging lines are compiled as if they were comment lines."; 2023: "SOURCE-COMPUTER. [ computer-name-1 ] . (format has no WITH DEBUGGING MODE clause)". The 2023 SOURCE-COMPUTER format offers only computer-name-1, and no candidate mentions the WITH DEBUGGING MODE clause or debugging lines, so the clause and its default rule are dropped.
